nights.title: SON MIEUX - 24 Hours - EU Album Tour
nights.name: Son Mieux
nights.extract: Son Mieux is a Dutch indie pop group from The Hague headed by Camiel Meiresonne.

nights.title: Strangelove - The DEPECHE MODE Experience Black Celebration 2026
nights.name: Strangelove
nights.extract: Strangelove were an English alternative rock band, formed in Bristol in 1991 comprising singer Patrick Duff, guitarists Alex Lee & Julian Poole, bassist Joe Allen and John Langley on drums. They released two EPs and three albums before disbanding in 1998.

nights.title: JULIA WOLF - Deep End World Tour 2026
nights.name: Julia Wolf
nights.extract: Julia Jade Capello, known professionally as Julia Wolf, is an American singer. Known for her ethereal vocals and self-produced alt-pop sound, she blends elements of indie pop, alternative rock, and R&B. Capello gained early attention on TikTok before releasing her debut EP Girls in Purgatory (2021) and her studio albums Good Thing We Stayed (2023) and Pressure (2025).

nights.title: Pa Sheehy - The Magic We Found Tour
nights.name: Pa Sheehy
nights.extract: Patrick "Pa" Sheehy is an Irish singer-songwriter from Dingle, County Kerry.

nights.title: Ayra Starr: Starrgirl World Tour
nights.name: Ayra Starr
nights.extract: Oyinkansola Sarah Aderibigbe, known professionally as Ayra Starr, is a Beninese-born Nigerian singer-songwriter and producer.
